slides.texte_overlay:
the quiet habits of people
who always seem put together

they reset every evening

they spend ten minutes each evening putting things back where they belong. a calm home in the morning is the secret behind people who never look rushed.

they plan tomorrow tonight

they write tomorrow's three priorities before bed. waking up already knowing what matters most quietly removes the chaos before the day has even started.

they keep a simple wardrobe

they own fewer clothes that all go together. getting dressed takes two minutes, and they always look like they made an effort without ever really trying.

they keep learning

they spend 5 minutes a day learning something new: a word, a painting, a moment in history. put together people have put together minds, and curiosity keeps them sharp.

they leave early

they leave ten minutes before they need to, every single time. arriving calm instead of out of breath is half of what makes someone look put together.
